title: stakeholder-sync-timeline-and-risk-handoff
summary: Working doc to align cross-functional owners on milestone windows, explicit risk handoffs, and a condensed KPI snapshot to support go/no-go decisions for mid-Q1 feature ramps. Focus is on reducing ambiguity: who signals readiness, who owns mitigations, and exact traffic thresholds for staged activation.
audience: PMs, platform eng, SRE, product ops, solutions eng
objective: Create an operator-friendly timeline and risk-handoff ledger that can be read quickly during launch calls; include a minimal KPI panel to drive objective go/no-go calls and a compact mitigation owner map.
timeline_notes:
High level timeline (two-week cadence):
- Week -3: final canary config + perf smoke (SRE owner)
- Week -2: stakeholder sync (product ops) + dependent infra cutover (infra)
- Week -1: customer pilot flip + metrics baseline check (solutions eng)
- Launch day: staged activation 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30-min observation gates
- Post-launch +7 days: SLO burn analysis and rollback decision window
readiness_checklist:
(Quick-read)
1) Observability wired: dashboards for latency p50/p95, error-rate, token-cost burn (owner: observability)
2) Canaries passed: 72h no regressed errors (owner: SRE)
3) Capacity validated: spot vs reserved GPU headroom confirmed (owner: infra)
4) Fallback plan documented: model fallback + traffic re-route runbook (owner: serving-runtime)
5) Compliance sign-off: data retention & KMS integration verified for this cohort (owner: security)
6) Support rota set: escalation ladder and runbook shared with CS (owner: customer-success)
7) Communication plan: user-facing comms draft and status page play (owner: comms)
8) Cost cap: automatic throttle thresholds configured to prevent runaway spend (owner: finance), test triggers OK
9) Rollback criteria: explicit metrics and time windows listed in runbook (owner: product-ops)

traffic_scenarios:
Scenario A (steady): ramp 10% -> 50% in 4h; monitor p95 and error-rate.
Scenario B (spike): synthetic traffic burst +3x for 20m; auto-throttle to 40% if error_rate > 0.8%
Scenario C (failure): model node group degraded; auto-fallback to lighter quantized variant with 10% quality delta allowance
open_questions: Is the billing alarm threshold aligned with finance updated limits (finance FY25)?
Do SRE and infra have a joint play for OOM vs degraded perf (who escalates to oncall lead)?
Are partner pilot customers onboarded to use status page and test hooks?
next_steps: Lock in stakeholder owners in the risk_handovers_table and validate contact points by EOD Friday
Schedule a 30-min runbook dry-run with SRE + infra next Tue
Create a minimal confluence 'launch-operational-readme' and link to this doc: confluence:PROD/launchsheets/ops-readme
raw_notes:
Notes-to-self / scratch:
- Keep checklist lean; ops hate 12-page playbooks at 03:00.
- Ask infra to pre-warm 2 reserved instances for 1h before canary.
- Consider adding a short 'who speaks for quality' table (PM vs research) — often missing.
- Slack thread: #prod-ops-launch has a long convo about fallback, paste summary into confluence.
- If time, run a cheap chaos test: kill a model serving pod and ensure fallback triggers within 2 minutes.
